description: Wave 3 — August 2026 Founder selection. 30 identities: ROSE (10), SKYE (10), ELITE (10). 29 entries sourced from August 2026 supplier pool (fragrance-list-2026-08). 1 entry (MIP-000006) sourced from Mid-Year 2026 Supplier List via MIP governance track. Wave 3 selection authorised by Founder per EP-CAT-P10C (2026-08-21). Research scope defined in wave-3-2026-research.json. External research to be conducted in EP-CAT-P10D.

governance.note: supplierName values are exact from pool source file. Where supplier text contains misspellings, accent omissions, or brand name abbreviations, the canonical identity is resolved in the paired research file. MIP-000006 is sourced from the Mid-Year 2026 Supplier List (not the August 2026 pool); its MIP provenance and verified status are preserved from identity-registry.json.
